6c5398f22f.q: What clinical problem does EndoShunt solve in trauma surgery?
6c5398f22f.a: EndoShunt was born out of clinical frustration felt by trauma surgeons when treating critically injured patients who are actively bleeding to death from anatomically protected locations. The device allows surgeons to keep vital organs alive in the body while giving them time to access and repair the injury, preventing patients from bleeding out before treatment can be delivered.

2be37e03e0.q: What is the Golden Hour concept in trauma surgery that EndoShunt addresses?
2be37e03e0.a: The Golden Hour is the concept in trauma medicine that if a patient can reach a trauma surgeon within the first hour of injury, their chances of survival are highest. The more minutes it takes to reach a trauma surgeon, the worse the outcome. EndoShunt extends this window by keeping vital organs viable during transport and before surgical access.
